thesis: Apple remains financially strong, but the valuation and weakening short-term trend require clearer earnings support before a bullish conclusion is justified.
strongest_counterexample: The decline may be a technical pullback rather than a fundamental deterioration because price remains above the 200-day average and free cash flow is substantial.
invalidation_conditions: A sustained break below the 200-day average
Deterioration in margins or free cash flow
Further analyst downgrades or lower earnings estimates
evidence_gaps: No breakdown of debt maturity or cash-flow allocation
decisive_factors: $98.8B free cash flow alongside elevated leverage
Price below the 20- and 50-day averages with negative MACD
source_note: Fresh Layer 1 data plus current-session English research-only analysis. Portfolio and Layer 5 are excluded.
